question: The base of a right pyramid is an equilateral triangle with side 10 cm, and its vertical height is 24 cm. Find the volume (in {cm}³ ) of the pyramid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a pyramid = (1/3) × Base Area × Height

Base Area (Equilateral Triangle) = (√3 / 4) × (side)² = (√3 / 4) × 10² = 25√3 cm²

Volume = (1/3) × 25√3 × 24 = 200√3 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 200√3 cm³.**
